scope: Finite exact-real restart, top-k utility, attention schedules, failure controls, and a packaged DLR shell bound

theorems.name: Mettapedia.ProbabilityTheory.MarkovChain.Restart.l1_sub_comm
theorems.statement: (x y : ι → ℝ) : l1 (x - y) = l1 (y - x)

theorems.name: Mettapedia.ProbabilityTheory.MarkovChain.Restart.l1_triangle_sub
theorems.statement:
(x y z : ι → ℝ) :
    l1 (x - z) ≤ l1 (x - y) + l1 (y - z)

theorems.name: Mettapedia.ProbabilityTheory.MarkovChain.Restart.abs_coordinate_le_l1
theorems.statement: (x : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) : |x i| ≤ l1 x

theorems.name: Mettapedia.ProbabilityTheory.MarkovChain.Restart.RestartWalk.error_le_change
theorems.statement:
(s x : ι → ℝ) :
    l1 (x - W.ppr s) ≤ l1 (W.step s x - x) / W.α

theorems.name: Mettapedia.ProbabilityTheory.MarkovChain.Restart.RestartWalk.next_error_le
theorems.statement:
(s x : ι → ℝ) :
    l1 (W.step s x - W.ppr s) ≤
      (1 - W.α) / W.α * l1 (W.step s x - x)

theorems.name: Mettapedia.ProbabilityTheory.MarkovChain.Restart.RestartWalk.outside_mass_le_leakage
theorems.statement:
(S : Finset ι) (ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)
    {s : ι → ℝ} (hs : ∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) (hs1 : mass s = 1)
    (hsS : ∀ i, i ∉ S → s i = 0)
    (hleak : ∀ j ∈ S, ∑ i ∈ Sᶜ, W.P i j ≤ ℓ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Sᶜ, W.ppr s i ≤ (1 - W.α) * ℓ / (W.α + (1 - W.α) * ℓ)

theorems.name: Mettapedia.ProbabilityTheory.MarkovChain.Restart.RestartWalk.ppr_ge_depth
theorems.statement:
{s : ι → ℝ} (hs : ∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) (t : ℕ) (j : ι) :
    W.α * (1 - W.α) ^ t * ((W.P ^ t) *ᵥ s) j ≤ W.ppr s j

theorems.name: Mettapedia.Algorithms.Retrieval.TopKSelection.isTopK_iff
theorems.statement:
(a : ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) (k : ℕ) :
    IsTopK a T k ↔ T.card = k ∧ ∀ i ∈ T, ∀ j ∉ T, a j ≤ a i

theorems.name: Mettapedia.Algorithms.Retrieval.TopKSelection.topk_frozen
theorems.statement:
(x y : ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) (e : ℝ)
    (hmargin : ∀ i ∈ T, ∀ j ∉ T, 2 * e < x i - x j)
    (herr : ∀ i, |x i - y i| ≤ e) :
    ∀ i ∈ T, ∀ j ∉ T, y j < y i

theorems.name: Mettapedia.Algorithms.Retrieval.TopKSelection.certified_topk
theorems.statement:
(W : RestartWalk ι) (s x : ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) (k : ℕ)
    (hcard : T.card = k)
    (hmargin : ∀ i ∈ T, ∀ j ∉ T,
      2 * ((1 - W.α) / W.α * l1 (W.step s x - x)) < W.step s x i - W.step s x j) :
    IsTopK (W.ppr s) T k

theorems.name: Mettapedia.Algorithms.Retrieval.TopKSelection.topk_scale
theorems.statement:
(a : ι → ℝ) (T : Finset ι) (k : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (h : IsTopK a T k) : IsTopK (c • a) T k

theorems.name: Mettapedia.Algorithms.Retrieval.TopKSelection.topk_regret_le_symmDiff
theorems.statement:
(q a : ι → ℝ) (T O : Finset ι) (k : ℕ)
    (hT : IsTopK a T k) (hO : O.card = k) :
    (∑ i ∈ O, q i) - ∑ i ∈ T, q i ≤ ∑ i ∈ T ∆ O, |q i - a i|

theorems.name: Mettapedia.Algorithms.Retrieval.TopKSelection.topk_regret_le_l1
theorems.statement:
(q a : ι → ℝ) (T O : Finset ι) (k : ℕ)
    (hT : IsTopK a T k) (hO : O.card = k) :
    (∑ i ∈ O, q i) - ∑ i ∈ T, q i ≤ l1 (q - a)

theorems.name: Mettapedia.Algorithms.Retrieval.TopKSelection.topk_regret_le_l1_scaled
theorems.statement:
(q a : ι → ℝ) (T O : Finset ι) (k : ℕ)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hT : IsTopK a T k) (hO : O.card = k) :
    (∑ i ∈ O, q i) - ∑ i ∈ T, q i ≤ l1 (q - c • a)

theorems.name: Mettapedia.Algorithms.Retrieval.TopKSelection.topk_regret_le_uniform
theorems.statement:
(q a : ι → ℝ) (T O : Finset ι) (k : ℕ)
    (e : ℝ) (he : 0 ≤ e) (herr : ∀ i, |q i - a i| ≤ e)
    (hT : IsTopK a T k) (hO : O.card = k) :
    (∑ i ∈ O, q i) - ∑ i ∈ T, q i ≤ 2 * k * e

theorems.name: Mettapedia.Algorithms.Retrieval.TopKSelection.calibrated_topk_optimal
theorems.statement:
(a : ι → ℝ) (T O : Finset ι) (k : ℕ)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hT : IsTopK a T k) (hO : O.card = k) :
    ∑ i ∈ O, c * a i ≤ ∑ i ∈ T, c * a i

theorems.name: Mettapedia.Algorithms.Retrieval.TopKSelection.topk_regret_le_max
theorems.statement:
[Nonempty ι] (q a : ι → ℝ) (T O : Finset ι) (k : ℕ)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hT : IsTopK a T k) (hO : O.card = k) :
    (∑ i ∈ O, q i) - ∑ i ∈ T, q i ≤
      2 * k * Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => |q i - c * a i|)

theorems.name: Mettapedia.Logic.MarkovLogicLocalQueryApproximation.shell_query_error
theorems.statement:
(M : ClassicalInfiniteGroundMLNSpec Atom ClauseId)
    {C : ℝ} (hC_nonneg : 0 ≤ C) (hC_lt_one : C < 1)
    (hC_bound : ∀ Δ : Region Atom, M.finiteRegionPairwiseDobrushinConstant Δ ≤ C)
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure (InfiniteWorld Atom))
    (hμ : FixedRegionCylinderDLR M.toStrictlyPositiveInfiniteGroundMLNSpec
      (μ : Measure (InfiniteWorld Atom)))
    (Γ : Region Atom) (q : LocalConstraintQuery Atom Γ) (n : ℕ)
    (ξ : BoundaryCondition Atom) :
    let ν : ProbabilityMeasure (InfiniteWorld Atom)

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Equilibrium.lazy_transport
theorems.statement:
(P : Kernel ι) (d : ℝ) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1)
    (x : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) :
    FiniteMassTransport.transport (lazyKernel P d hd0 hd1) x i =
      (1-d) * x i + d * FiniteMassTransport.transport P x i

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Equilibrium.continuation_nonneg
theorems.statement:
(ρ d : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    0 ≤ continuation ρ d

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Equilibrium.continuation_lt_one
theorems.statement:
(ρ d : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (hd : 0 ≤ d) :
    continuation ρ d < 1

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Equilibrium.lazy_ppr_eq_ppr
theorems.statement:
(P : Kernel ι) (d ρ : ℝ)
    (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (s : ι → ℝ) :
    (restartingWalk (lazyKernel P d hd0 hd1) ρ hρ0 hρ1).ppr s =
    (restartingWalk P (continuation ρ d)
      (continuation_nonneg ρ d hρ0 hρ1 hd0)
      (continuation_lt_one ρ d hρ0 hρ1 hd0)).ppr s

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Equilibrium.mean_hops
theorems.statement:
(ρ d : ℝ) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) :
    continuation ρ d / (1 - continuation ρ d) = ρ*d / (1-ρ)

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Equilibrium.impulse_zero
theorems.statement: (W : RestartWalk ι) (v : ι → ℝ) : impulse W 0 v = v

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Equilibrium.impulse_add
theorems.statement:
(W : RestartWalk ι) (n : ℕ) (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    impulse W n (x+y) = impulse W n x + impulse W n y

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Equilibrium.impulse_succ
theorems.statement:
(W : RestartWalk ι) (n : ℕ) (v : ι → ℝ) :
    impulse W 1 (impulse W n v) = impulse W (n+1) v

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Equilibrium.sti_cycle
theorems.statement:
(W : RestartWalk ι) (u v : ι → ℝ) :
    W.step (W.α⁻¹ • u) v = u + impulse W 1 v

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Equilibrium.stimulate_spread_decay
theorems.statement:
(W : RestartWalk ι) (raw v : ι → ℝ) :
    impulse W 1 (v + raw) =
      W.step (W.α⁻¹ • impulse W 1 raw) v

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Equilibrium.sti_unroll
theorems.statement:
(W : RestartWalk ι) (u : ℕ → ι → ℝ) (v : ι → ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    stiRun W u v t = impulse W t v +
      ∑ τ ∈ Finset.range t, impulse W (t-1-τ) (u τ)

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Equilibrium.sti_steady_state
theorems.statement:
(W : RestartWalk ι) (u v : ι → ℝ) (t : ℕ) :
    l1 (stiRun W (fun _ => u) v t - W.α⁻¹ • W.ppr u) ≤
      (1-W.α)^t * l1 (v - W.α⁻¹ • W.ppr u)

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Equilibrium.lazy_ppr_tail
theorems.statement:
(P : Kernel ι) (d ρ : ℝ)
    (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd1 : d ≤ 1) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ < 1)
    (s : ι → ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) (k : ℕ) :
    let V := restartingWalk P (continuation ρ d)
      (continuation_nonneg ρ d hρ0 hρ1 hd0)
      (continuation_lt_one ρ d hρ0 hρ1 hd0)
    ∑ i ∈ (V.reach s k)ᶜ, (restartingWalk (lazyKernel P d hd0 hd1) ρ hρ0 hρ1).ppr s i ≤
      (continuation ρ d)^(k+1) * mass s

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Relevance.concept_shortcut
theorems.statement:
(W : RestartWalk ι) (i C j : ι) (β w : ℝ)
    (hβ : W.P C i = β) (hw : W.P j C = w) :
    W.α * (1-W.α)^2 * β * w ≤ W.ppr (Pi.single i 1) j

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Relevance.spreading_regret
theorems.statement:
(W : RestartWalk ι) (s q : ι → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, 0 ≤ s i) (hs1 : mass s = 1)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (r k : ℕ) (T O : Finset ι)
    (hT : IsTopK ((W.step s)^[r] s) T k) (hO : O.card = k) :
    (∑ i ∈ O, q i) - ∑ i ∈ T, q i ≤
      l1 (q - c • W.ppr s) + 2*c*(1-W.α)^r

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.Relevance.walk_generated_needs_optimal
theorems.statement:
(W : RestartWalk ι) (s q : ι → ℝ)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hq : q = c • W.ppr s)
    (T O : Finset ι) (k : ℕ) (hT : IsTopK (W.ppr s) T k) (hO : O.card = k) :
    ∑ i ∈ O, q i ≤ ∑ i ∈ T, q i

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.SpreadingExamples.hub_first
theorems.statement: : hubWalk.step hubSeed hubSeed = hubFirst

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.SpreadingExamples.hub_second
theorems.statement: : hubWalk.step hubSeed hubFirst = hubSecond

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.SpreadingExamples.hub_fixed
theorems.statement: : hubWalk.ppr hubSeed = hubSecond

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.SpreadingExamples.extra_round_lowers_recall
theorems.statement:
:
    IsTopK hubFirst 2 Finset.univ {a, b} ∧
    IsTopK hubSecond 2 Finset.univ {a, h} ∧
    (({a, b} : Finset HubNode) ∩ {b}).card = 1 ∧
    (({a, h} : Finset HubNode) ∩ {b}).card = 0 ∧
    hubWalk.ppr hubSeed = hubSecond

theorems.name: Mettapedia.CognitiveArchitecture.Attention.SpreadingExamples.usefulness_gain_not_concave
theorems.statement:
:
    bridgeHits 0 = 0 ∧ bridgeHits 1 = 0 ∧ bridgeHits 2 = 0 ∧
    bridgeHits 3 = 2 ∧
    bridgeHits 2 - bridgeHits 1 < bridgeHits 3 - bridgeHits 2

qualification_limits: No learned-graph usefulness or calibrated need probabilities are established.
No native floating-point correctness or live context selection is established.
The strict-gap stop need not terminate at a tie.
Calibration-dominated error is not zero remaining benefit or concavity of utility.
ECAN caller schedules are explicit hypotheses; no global runtime cycle is assumed.
The DLR shell theorem is not convergence of a loopy BP implementation.
All existing CognitiveArchitecture/GodelClaw files remain unchanged.
